experiments.launch:
set -u
started=$(date +%s)
finish() {
	printf '\nhl-launch: code=%d started=%d ended=%d\n' "$1" "$started" "$(date +%s)"
	exit "$1"
}
say() { echo "launch: $*" >&2; }
pid=
stop() {
	trap '' TERM
	[ -n "$pid" ] || finish 143
	kill -s TERM 0
	(sleep "$HYPOTHESISLOOP_STOP_GRACE"; kill -s KILL "$pid" 2>/dev/null) &
}
trap stop TERM
fetch() { git -c "http.extraHeader=Authorization: Bearer $HYPOTHESISLOOP_TOKEN" "$@"; }
commit=${HYPOTHESISLOOP_CODE_REF##*@}
mkdir -p /workspace/code && git -C /workspace/code init -q || { say "could not make a git repository at /workspace/code: the image's user must be able to create it"; finish 1; }
try=1
pause=5
while ! said=$(fetch -C /workspace/code fetch -q --depth 1 "$HYPOTHESISLOOP_GIT_URL" "$commit" 2>&1); do
	said=$(printf '%s' "$said" | tr '\n' ' ')
	if [ "$try" -ge 7 ]; then
		if fetch ls-remote -q "$HYPOTHESISLOOP_GIT_URL" HEAD >/dev/null 2>&1; then
			say "commit $commit is not in the repository, which answers: $said"
			finish 1
		fi
		say "the repository did not answer in $try tries, so the command never ran and the platform queues the job again: $said"
		finish 75
	fi
	say "try $try of 7 to fetch commit $commit failed, the next in ${pause}s: $said"
	try=$((try + 1))
	sleep "$pause"
	pause=$((pause * 2 > 60 ? 60 : pause * 2))
done
git -C /workspace/code checkout -q FETCH_HEAD && cd /workspace/code || finish 1
"$@" &
pid=$!
while :; do
	wait "$pid"
	code=$?
	kill -0 "$pid" 2>/dev/null || break
done
finish "$code"
